name: @dewbow/workspace
description: Self-hosted Codex session management across machines

scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @dewbow/protocol && npm run build --workspace @dewbow/sdk && npm run build --workspace @dewbow/ui && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @dewbow/protocol && npm run build --workspace @dewbow/ui && npm test --workspaces --if-present && node --test scripts/tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.host-daemon: npm run build --workspace @dewbow/protocol && npm run build --workspace @dewbow/sdk && npm run build --workspace @dewbow/host-daemon && npm run start --workspace @dewbow/host-daemon --
scripts.control-plane: npm run build --workspace @dewbow/protocol && npm run build --workspace @dewbow/control-plane && npm run start --workspace @dewbow/control-plane --
scripts.local:up: npm run build && node scripts/local-live.mjs up
